title: mesosphaerum lappaceum
intro: Mesosphaerum lappaceum, commonly known as "Lemon-scented Coleus" or "Mexican Coleus", is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory issues, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Mesosphaerum lappaceum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are known to possess anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antispasmodic properties. Further research is needed to confirm the full extent of its therapeutic actions and bioactive constituents.
